_comment: Services VCSIDE knows how to talk to. Choosing one fills the address and the protocol; the models are asked of the service itself once a key is saved. The Gemini address and its list of models are from Google's 'OpenAI compatibility' page (read 2026-11-11); the others are from general knowledge and to be verified (docs/sources.md).

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.note: Through Google's OpenAI-compatible address. The key is made in Google AI Studio.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.note: One key for many models from many makers (a long list: type to filter it).
